03 · The dye house

Fermented, not poured.

Our indigo is sukumo, composted leaves, kept alive in a vat with wood ash and wheat bran. Cloth goes in pale green and turns blue only when it meets air. There is no shortcut, and no two vats behave the same.

VISIT THE WORKSHOP

04 · How a cloth is made
01

Scour

Raw linen is boiled to remove oils so the vat can take hold.

02

Dip

Hand-dipped, squeezed and opened to the air. Repeated for depth.

03

Oxidise

Green turns blue in minutes. This is the whole trick.

04

Rinse & dry

Rinsed in cold water, line dried in the shade.

pages.label: Our dye house
pages.html:
Home/Our dye house

染工房

A converted rice mill, eight vats and four people. We dye what we sell, and we sell what we dye.

Since 2019

Slow colour.

We started with one vat and a borrowed book. Today we keep eight, each named after the month it was started. The oldest, in its seventh year, produces the deepest, most even blue we know.

Replace this copy with your workshop's real history, people and place.

What we hold to
一

Natural indigo only

No synthetic shortcuts, no pre-reduced powder.

二

Small lots

No more than 60 pieces from one dip.

三

Mend, don't discard

Free re-dye on any piece, any age.

四

Honest labels

Dip counts printed on every tag.

pages.label: Care guide
pages.html:
Home/Care guide

手入れ

Indigo is a living colour. A few habits keep it blue for years.

01

Wash alone

For the first three washes, in cold water, with a neutral soap.

02

No bleach

Not even oxygen bleach. It strips the blue.

03

Dry in shade

Direct sun fades indigo unevenly.

04

Re-dye

Send it back. We will bring the colour up again.

pages.label: FAQ
pages.html:
Home/FAQ

よくある質問

Will indigo stain my skin or clothes?

Slightly, in the first washes. Wash alone and the transfer fades.

Can I request a specific shade?

Yes. Choose one of the six shades or send us a swatch. Allow 10 working days.

Do you do wholesale?

Yes, minimum 20 pieces. Use the contact form.

Is it vegan?

Yes. Indigo is plant-based; our vat uses wood ash and wheat bran.
